item.title: Turkish president appoints new Justice and Interior ministers in cabinet reshuffle
item.description: Istanbul Chief Public Prosecutor Akin Gurlek has been named Justice Minister, while Erzurum Governor Mustafa Ciftci takes over the Interior Ministry.

item.title: Six influential names surface in Epstein files raising fresh scrutiny and alarm
item.description: Senior US lawmakers review unredacted Epstein materials during two-hour Justice Department visit on Monday, finding roughly 70 to 80 percent of files still redacted.

item.title: Canada 'devastated' as 'horrific' mass shooting leaves multiple dead
item.description: Royal Canadian Mounted Police confirm that at least ten people, including a suspected shooter, have died following a mass shooting in the town of Tumbler Ridge.

item.title: Australia charges two Chinese nationals with foreign interference
item.description: Two Chinese nationals, accused of spying on a Canberra Buddhist group for Chinese police, have been charged with foreign interference in Australia.

item.title: Millions of young voters head to polls in Bangladesh's first post-Hasina election
item.description: Nearly half of Bangladesh's 129 million voters are aged 18-27 as the country holds its first election since a 2024 student-led uprising ended Sheikh Hasina's 15-year rule

item.title: Commonwealth chief signals momentum towards slavery reparations talks
item.description: From the 15th to the 19th century, at least 12.5 million Africans were abducted and sold into slavery by European merchants

item.title: Hundreds rally outside Australian parliament against Israeli president’s visit
item.description: Demonstrators, lawmakers and rights groups pressure Canberra over Gaza deaths and police response as Israeli president tours Australia

item.title: US to deploy 200 troops to train Nigerian forces in fight against terrorists
item.description: The deployment will expand military cooperation between Washington and Abuja, focusing on training, intelligence support and coordination of air and ground operations, with no direct US combat role.

item.title: Russian strike on Ukraine kills four, including three children: official
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy calls on Western allies to step up pressure on Moscow.

item.title: 'It's time to get aggressive': Bodycam footage undermines DHS account of Chicago shooting
item.description: Newly released video and messages raise fresh questions about a Border Patrol agent who shot a US citizen during an immigration operation — and about how the government portrayed the incident.
